parameters.content:
## What this does

You have a sheet with a column called company, holding names or registration numbers. This fills in the official register data next to each one and writes it back.

Every country returns the same field names, so one set of columns works for all seven. No mapping per country.

Czechia (ARES), Estonia (Ariregister), Finland (PRH), France (Annuaire des Entreprises), Norway (Bronnoysund), Poland (MF VAT list), Slovakia (RPO).

## Setup

1. Install the Apify node. It is verified by n8n, so it works on Cloud and on self-hosted.
2. Add your Apify API key in the node credentials. A free Apify account is enough to start.
3. Point the two Google Sheets nodes at your sheet. Column A holds the company names.

The Actor is gubidonius/company-registry-lookup. One row comes back per company with the
same 28 field names whichever of the seven registers answered.


## Adapted template
This version uses standard HTTP Request nodes with a header credential for Apify and Google Sheets OAuth2. No community-node installation is required. Actor options, complete waiting/results and the eleven mapped fields are retained. Sheet append uses the append API after matched-cell updates.
